# Fluent UI System Icons

Unmodified SVG assets from Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons, npm package `@fluentui/svg-icons` 1.1.345, MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons
Archive SHA-256: `6610366b1eb5ce4ce70c95d11accbf8858b01ec81c71d31bc6493586ac8cc905`.

`assets/icons/microphone-off.svg` and `assets/icons/camera-off.svg` are local
adaptations of the corresponding listed microphone and camera SVGs, with a
diagonal line added to indicate the disabled state. They retain the MIT license.
